Safety Administration (PHMSA), Office of Pipeline Safety (OPS), pursuant to Chapter 601 of 49
United States Code (U.S.C.) performed an integrated inspection of ANR Pipeline Co’s (ANR)
inspection system #1168 in various locations throughout Mississippi, Tennessee, Arkansas,
Louisiana and Kentucky.
